why_ai: Faculty teach, mentor and supervise research in person on residential campuses, and families pay for an institution's degree and reputation, though lecture content and administration are increasingly substitutable.
why_clarity: Courses and credit rules recur every term, but what counts as learning is contested and outcomes such as completion and earnings surface years later.
why_digital: Teaching happens mostly in classrooms, labs and residence halls; students choose by visiting and recruiting is regional to national, with a growing online share.

why_ai: Forecasting, targeting and aid modelling are screen work that analytics absorbs; the enrollment VP's accountability for the class and the relationships with families keep some judgement human.
why_clarity: Deposits, discount rate and net tuition are counted exactly each cycle, but the effect of any single recruitment or aid decision is confounded and known only after the class arrives.
why_digital: Prospect, aid and enrollment data are digital and vendors serve colleges remotely, though campus visits and counsellor travel remain.

why_ai: Name buying, segmentation and campaign execution are what marketing software and AI already automate.
why_clarity: Responses and applications are measured quickly against a known funnel, though enrollment attribution lags two years.
why_digital: Names, campaigns and CRM journeys are fully digital and agencies sell nationally.

why_ai: Uplift and grid modelling are computational, but the aid director's appeal decisions under professional judgment are accountable and consequential.
why_clarity: Discount rate and class size are exact, but whether a grant dollar changed a decision is a counterfactual estimated, not observed.
why_digital: Admit and aid records are digital; appeals still involve calls with families and committee review on campus.

why_ai: Award reading, budgeting and reconciliation are document work that AI handles well, while signing institutional certifications and negotiating with agencies stay accountable human roles.
why_clarity: Cost principles and agency terms are written down and awards recur in volume, though audit outcomes arrive a year or more later.
why_digital: Awards, ledgers and portals are digital; departmental administrators and PIs are served on campus.

why_ai: Evidence retrieval and drafting automate, but the argument to peer reviewers and the site visit remain human and reputational.
why_clarity: Standards are published but judged by peer reviewers, each cycle is years apart, and findings arrive months after submission.
why_digital: Evidence is documents and data, but site visits are in person and accreditors are regional bodies.

why_ai: Matching courses to equivalents from catalogues and precedent is a retrieval task that models perform, with faculty review for the tail.
why_clarity: Each course is posted as equivalent, elective or no credit thousands of times a term, with faculty decisions as a clear check.
why_digital: Transcripts and catalogues are documents, some still paper, processed on screen by registrars.

why_ai: Serving small colleges' back offices is compliance and processing work that agents can carry, though presidents buy from providers they trust and some roles are placed on campus.
why_clarity: Federal deadlines and processes are fixed and identical across colleges, and a missed date is visible immediately.
why_digital: Systems and reporting are digital, but managed-service providers still place CIOs and staff on site.

why_ai: Identification and outreach automate; coaching adults back to completion relies on human encouragement and trust.
why_clarity: Re-enrollment is counted each term, but completion takes years and causes of return are mixed.
why_digital: Former-student records and outreach are digital and much coaching is remote, though returning students attend courses.

why_ai: Document reading, ISIR reconciliation and status questions are rule-bound and directly automatable; counsellors keep certification and professional judgment.
why_clarity: Federal verification rules define exactly what each file needs, files recur by the thousand, and errors show in reprocessed ISIRs.
why_digital: ISIRs, documents and awards are digital, and processing is already outsourced by some colleges.

why_ai: Survey items are defined in writing and computed from structured data, work software and AI absorb, with the keyholder accountable for the submission.
why_clarity: IPEDS and Common Data Set definitions are codified, repeat every year and pass or fail edit checks.
why_digital: Structured SIS and HR data in, electronic submissions out, done on screen.

why_ai: Clients pay for a trusted firm's model and advice in a high-stakes cycle, but the modelling itself is computational and AI-native tools compete.
why_clarity: Grids and forecasts recur each cycle and are checked against deposits within months.
why_digital: Client data in, models and advice out, delivered remotely with some campus visits.

why_ai: Ratings committees carry regulatory accountability and investor trust, and the bond market will keep requiring them.
why_clarity: Methodologies are published and surveillance recurs annually, but whether a rating was right shows over years of defaults and transitions.
why_digital: Financial statements and disclosures in, ratings published online, sold to issuers nationwide.

why_ai: Cost allocation and space analysis are rule-bound and automatable; negotiation experience with federal agencies keeps some trust in named advisors.
why_clarity: Cost principles and rate methods are codified and studies recur every few years per university, with negotiated outcomes as the check.
why_digital: Ledgers and space data are digital, with some on-site survey work, and firms serve universities nationally.

why_ai: Research synthesis and benchmarking are tasks AI performs well; members pay partly for advisers' access and brand.
why_clarity: Studies vary by question and their usefulness is judged slowly by members.
why_digital: Surveys, interviews and reports are digital and sold remotely by membership.

why_ai: Assembled public scholarship and demand data are replicable by AI-native analytics; the brand with provosts is most of the moat.
why_clarity: Metrics are defined and recomputed regularly, though whether a programme decision was right shows years later.
why_digital: Public and licensed data in, dashboards and reports out, sold online.

why_ai: Risk scoring and nudging are software functions that SIS vendors and AI-native tools replicate.
why_clarity: Persistence is measured every term against clear census outcomes.
why_digital: Student data in, software out, sold to institutions as SaaS.

why_ai: Registered municipal advisors owe fiduciary duties and advise boards on consequential, bespoke transactions where the relationship matters.
why_clarity: Debt and merger analyses follow standard methods but every transaction differs, and outcomes are known years later.
why_digital: Financial models are digital, but advice is delivered in board meetings and through relationships.

why_ai: Lead scoring and channel optimisation are marketing analytics that platforms and AI substitute directly.
why_clarity: Leads convert or not at high volume each term, measured quickly.
why_digital: Fully digital marketing and analytics sold to universities remotely.

why_ai: Running an application platform is software operations, sustained by network effects rather than human judgement.
why_clarity: Applications are processed identically by the million each cycle.
why_digital: Applications, documents and reports are entirely online.

why_ai: Analytics and AI features on top of system-of-record data are software functions that competitors and AI-native tools replicate.
why_clarity: Reports and models are defined and recompute on schedules against known outcomes.
why_digital: Client records in, software out, sold as SaaS.

why_ai: Federal officials administer statutory programmes with legal accountability, and the programmes persist by law.
why_clarity: Eligibility formulas and IPEDS definitions are codified and run for millions of records each year.
why_digital: Applications and submissions are digital, but the work is run inside federal agencies under statute.

why_ai: Matching enrollment records is computational, but the near-census coverage and institutional trust are hard to replicate.
why_clarity: Record matching and reports recur on fixed definitions across millions of records.
why_digital: Institutional files in, reports and verifications online.

why_ai: Rankings are computed from submitted and public data by small teams, and the brand of the ranker is most of what is sold.
why_clarity: Methods are published but contested, and whether a ranking measures quality is rarely tested.
why_digital: Data in, rankings and licences out, all online.

why_ai: State agencies allocate funding with legal authority, a role that persists by statute.
why_clarity: Formulas are written, but their effect on institutional outcomes is contested and slow to observe.
why_digital: Unit records are digital, but the work serves one state's institutions under statute.

why_ai: Peer review with site visits carries the authority federal aid depends on, and policy keeps it human-led.
why_clarity: Standards and procedures are written, but judgements are peer-made and cycles are years apart.
why_digital: Documents are digital, but site visits are in person and accreditors are regional.

why_ai: Member surveys and benchmark reports are routine analysis software automates; the association relationship sustains them.
why_clarity: Survey instruments and reports repeat annually on fixed definitions.
why_digital: Member data in, reports out online to a national membership.

why_ai: Per-file aid processing is rule-bound document work that agents absorb, with the college retaining liability.
why_clarity: Federal rules define each file's steps and errors surface in reprocessing and reviews.
why_digital: Files and documents are digital and processed remotely for client colleges.
